pages.title: Where to look
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Frostbitten Temple.

pages.title: Locator search
pages.text: Use this encounter’s locator in the Overworld. It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat.

pages.title: Preparation
pages.text: Look for the Frostbitten Temple in snowy regions. Bring reliable melee equipment, food and healing, and leave a route out of the frontal sector. The current configuration enables arrow protection. Direct damage from thrown potions and area-effect clouds is also rejected.

pages.title: Wind-up → leave the sector
pages.text: Area strikes check broad frontal arcs. Move sideways and out of reach during the wind-up, then retaliate after the strike. Native sleep also rejects normal damage; distinguish it from a dedicated server waiting for Start.

pages.title: Difficulty and damage
pages.text: JEM corrects the inverted native difficulty offsets: the same attack is weaker on Easy than Normal and stronger on Hard. World tier and encounter mode further affect actual damage. An attack color does not identify its damage type or the right defense.

pages.title: Ordinary combat
pages.text: This profile does not use hosted preparation. Fight it normally rather than looking for Start. Defeating this enemy contributes to world-tier progression.

pages.title: Loot and use
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Frozen Rune. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory.

pages.title: Next step
pages.text: This victory belongs to the branch for: Maledictus. The other victories in that branch are also required. Sibling prerequisite encounters can be completed in any order.
